name: Markmonitor AnyCA REST Gateway Plugin
description: Markmonitor plugin for the AnyCA REST Gateway framework

ca_plugin_config.name: ApiKey
ca_plugin_config.description: The API Key for the MarkMonitor API

ca_plugin_config.name: Username
ca_plugin_config.description: Username for the MarkMonitor API service account

ca_plugin_config.name: Password
ca_plugin_config.description: Password for the MarkMonitor API service account

ca_plugin_config.name: BaseUrl
ca_plugin_config.description: The Base URL for the MarkMonitor API - Usually either https://api.markmonitor.com

ca_plugin_config.name: OrgId
ca_plugin_config.description: The name of the MarkMonitor Organization to use for the API calls (ex: MarkMonitor). You can also use the Organization ID in GUID format.

ca_plugin_config.name: Enabled
ca_plugin_config.description: Flag to Enable or Disable gateway functionality. Disabling is primarily used to allow creation of the CA prior to configuration information being available.

ca_plugin_config.name: TimeoutSeconds
ca_plugin_config.description: The HTTP request timeout, in seconds, for calls to the MarkMonitor API. Default is 120.

ca_plugin_config.name: PageSize
ca_plugin_config.description: The number of certificate orders requested per page during synchronization (1-500). Default is 100.

ca_plugin_config.name: ForceCompleteSync
ca_plugin_config.description: When true, bypasses the skip-unchanged optimization and re-emits every order on every synchronization. Default is false.

ca_plugin_config.name: PickupRetries
ca_plugin_config.description: How many times to poll a freshly-created order for issuance before returning it in its still-pending state. 0 disables polling. Default is 5.

ca_plugin_config.name: PickupDelaySeconds
ca_plugin_config.description: The delay, in seconds, between issuance pickup polls. Default is 10.

enrollment_config.name: AdditionalEmails
enrollment_config.description: List of 0 or more comma separated email addresses to send the certificate to via email after generation.

enrollment_config.name: MarkmonitorGroup
enrollment_config.description: The name or GUID of a Markmonitor group to use for the certificate request.

enrollment_config.name: MarkmonitorContact
enrollment_config.description: The name or GUID of a Markmonitor contact to use for the certificate request. Will use default Markmonitor organization contact if not specified.

enrollment_config.name: DCVMethod
enrollment_config.description: The method to use for Domain Control Validation (DCV). Valid values are EMAIL, DNS_CNAME_TOKEN, HTTP_TOKEN, DNS_TXT_TOKEN. Default is EMAIL.

enrollment_config.name: comments
enrollment_config.description: Comments to attach to the MarkMonitor order. Default is "Requested via Keyfactor Command".

enrollment_config.name: locale
enrollment_config.description: Locale to use for the MarkMonitor order. Default is "en".

enrollment_config.name: provider
enrollment_config.description: The certificate provider to use for the order. Default is "DIGICERT" (currently the only provider MarkMonitor's API supports).

enrollment_config.name: RenewalWindowDays
enrollment_config.description: For a RenewOrReissue enrollment, how many days before its expiration a prior certificate must be within before it is revoked after being replaced. Outside this window, the prior certificate is left unrevoked and the request is treated like a plain new issuance. Default is 90.
